name: captino
description: Connects Claude Code to the Captino MCP server (funnels, pages, forms, leads, performance, subscription) and adds skills for funnel analysis, drop-off diagnosis, lead review, lead follow-up, account reports, building funnel pages and building forms.

api_key.title: Captino MCP API key
api_key.description: Create one in the Captino app under Settings > MCP (/app/mcp-settings). Keys start with cap_mcp_. Grant at least Funnel, Contact, Performance and Subscription read access; add Contact write for lead follow-up, Funnel write to build pages and Form write to build forms.
